description.narrative:
UNOPS supports health in Madagascar through procurement and and installation of materials and equipment for three research laboratories, including the National Center for the Application of Pharmaceutical Research (CNARP), the Malagasy Institute of Veterinary Vaccines (IMVAVET), and the Center National Environmental Research (CNRE). UNOPS will also support the procurement of medical equipment and medical supplies for 347 Basic Health Centers and 23 operating theaters in University Hospital Centers.

This support will make it possible to strengthen the capacities of national research laboratories in terms of epidemiological surveillance, prevention and preparation for epidemics. On the other hand, strengthening the capacities and equipment available in the Basic Health Centers and operating theaters will make it possible to improve access to healthcare and services, particularly in terms of reproductive health and family planning in underserved communities.
